meta.description: Lets paths sense their neighbours like growing hyphae: they turn away from crowded places or bundle with paths close by, so a bundle of strands gets a fibrous, slightly irregular texture. Every path still follows where it was, it never strays further than the max offset, and its base stays where it is.

plant.description: The paths that sense each other, e.g. the strands of a stipe or a cap.

strength.description: How far the paths follow what they sense, as a share of the max offset. 0 leaves them where they are.

range.description: How far a path senses its neighbours. About two to three strand spacings gives cords of a few strands, larger values gather wider bands.

bundling.description: -1 turns paths away from their neighbours, so they spread evenly, 1 turns them towards each other, so they bundle into cords with gaps between them.

max_offset.description: The furthest a point strays from where it was. Strands of a guide leave its tube by at most this much.

depth.description: On which layers of paths to work, counted from the deepest. 1 works only on the deepest paths, e.g. the strands.
